Amsterdam UMC (location VUmc)
Radiology Dept
Date: 26 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: Rising PSA (10.92 ng/mL) with prior biopsy-proven prostate cancer. Request for staging and lesion characterisation.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume is 42.0 mL.
T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal, ill-defined hypointense lesion in the left peripheral zone, approximately 18 mm in greatest dimension.
Diffusion-weighted imaging shows marked restricted diffusion within this region, with low ADC values.
Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences reveal early, intense enhancement of the same area.
No extraprostatic extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified.
No suspicious lymphadenopathy or distant metastases are seen.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone.
Prostate-specific antigen density 0.26 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical stage cT1c.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8727174.

previous_notes.text: Patient attended for routine follow-up of known prostate cancer. PSA was 6.7 ng/mL, representing a continued upward trend from previous measurements. Discussed the rising values and the need for further urological evaluation. Referred to urology for re-evaluation and treatment planning.

previous_notes.author: Dr. P. van Dijk (GP)
previous_notes.text: Initial presentation with elevated PSA of 4.1 ng/mL. Discussed the possibility of prostate pathology and the need for tissue sampling. Referred for multiparametric MRI and subsequent biopsy. Patient advised to monitor for any urinary symptoms.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1 (earliest available): The specimen demonstrates acinar adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 3. A cribriform pattern is present within the tumour. Perineural invasion is absent. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone on the left side.

Overall trajectory: The available biopsy data shows a consistent high-grade presentation with no evidence of grade regression across the documented timepoint.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 5.
